answer: Edge weight in the trust graph decays a fixed fraction per epoch and recovers only when the vouched identity completes work. A recruiter may not sit on the panel reviewing its own recruit, which stops a hollow ring from scoring itself. Juries price the delta, not the absolute score on a profile, so six idle epochs cost the same account six steps of credit. Holding a shale field of silent accounts demands real uptime, and every dormant glacier month erases exactly what the vouches bought.
